name: claude-guards
description: Claude Code plugins: hooks that stop risky git, GitHub and shell commands, and the goal command, skills and hooks for working through a repo's todo list and landing pull requests

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Hooks that stop risky git, GitHub and shell commands an agent is about to run, and say what to do instead

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: The goal command and the skills around it: what to work on next, claiming it, opening the pull request with a fresh review and landing it; long-loops and add-knowledge; hooks that let an agent run a plain gh pr merge in auto mode, warn at a merge with no fresh review, and offer to share what Claude saves to memory
